title: Lip on a round rim with a 0.3 mm Tip Radius on both top edges

expect.note: plastic2_lip_round_rim less the two rounds: each takes the corner r^2 (1 - pi/4) (r = 0.3) round its edge; by Pappus the corners' centroids sit c inside the radii 8 and 7, so together 2 pi (8 - c + 7 + c) r^2 (1 - pi/4) = 30 pi r^2 (1 - pi/4).
